head: f76d277

rows.note: creative.tournament records funnel_rounds and creative.intake asks funnel.may_engineer of that run before queuing cir.draft; cir.draft re-asks it from the winner intake row (verify_funnel) so a direct enqueue is refused by name. A not-carried winner is never re-opened by a judgement.

intake.storyboard_for derives the thumbnail storyboard from the concept (framed by judged competitor hero shots when any exist); the gate reads it and premise_thumbnail no longer fails by absence. The mobile-grid judgement itself waits honestly on image_vision (external board + model_provider); regate_held now judges it via provider.see the day a board is filed and the vision probe passes, and records concept.judged with the judge's name.

intake records roi.design_provenance keyed on the stable design slug of the winning design with the plan's lesson_ids; compounding_report counts designs (latest record per design) and reports ideation briefs separately as briefs_recorded.

prospecting.propose calls preengineering.promise_for (invention.promise with execution read from the premise) on every generated concept and refuses listing-copy premises at generation; the gate carries an emotional_promise check (#109) and the brief records the promise.

intake.motifs_for produces the winner's motifs from its own words found in the season's MOTIF_GRAMMAR (with synonyms); the gate's motif_grammar check runs on that real selection and passes on a stockings winner, fails honestly when a concept names nothing from the grammar.

prospecting.tournament screens at the arena's real days_to_event and calls family.shift_capacity over research survivors; ideation.select prefers survivors the window says a buyer can still comfortably finish (hurry deferred, recorded as window_deferred).
ideation.skill_gap reads the latest radar.skill_gap row into the plan; constraints_text puts the missing level in every model brief and select prefers a winner that fills it (fills_skill_gap).
intake.wow_for reads the WOW mechanism from the premise's words or the construction with its grounding; the gate's wow check passes a grounded flagship and fails a flagship whose words carry none.

Software half built: tournament winners route through intake to cir.draft → cir.compile → gate.certify. Live shadow winners wait, unpassed, on the vision judgement (board = external image generation; judge = model_provider); the cadence names both and performs the judgement the day both exist.
ideation.plan reads gallery_image_observation rows per pod (intake.vision_readings); attributes reach every generator brief and frame the storyboard; with none the plan states UNMEASURED.

seasonal.remerchandising (weekly) generates the object-changing brief from every certified evergreen parent (transformation_brief), derives the child and records it; creative.tournament seeds those children into its field and the funnel judges them, recording each fate. Presentation layers still route to re-merchandising.

mjs.scan → sentinel-queued creative.tournament (seasonal_target) → intake → cir.draft → cir.compile → gate.certify; later stages (assets, launch) are read by advance_pipeline from their rows and stop honestly where owner/external gates hold (image generation, publishing).

The engineered variant is no longer 'held': a brief is generated per parent and the child enters the funnel; a fitted-garment winner would be authored by creative.prototype.author/garment_design in cir.draft. Owned photography remains external (model_bearing_render) and is read from asset rows by the pipeline walker.

intake.make_time_for plans per MAKER_SKILLS with launch dates for the skill the lane is written for; launch.plan window_decision and catalogue_plans use leadtime.maker_skill_for (printed difficulty → maker skill) and record make_time_by_skill.

The pre-engineering gate carries a half_life check: trend domain from the culture signal (or occasion/evergreen) classified and check_half_life applied to the make lane; a FLAGSHIP from a film-moment trend is refused before engineering.

listing.seo calls commerce.intent.listing_language (six-facet map from the product's own facts or its winning concept, phrases observed in benchmark titles, competition from SerpSnapshot or UNMEASURED); observed phrases join the query set and must_include tags.

The MJs cropped-cardigan listing runs end to end into a Christmas/garments tournament with cardigan concepts; the funnel's proposition stage applies #111's family test, which no fitted-garment construction passes (no quick companion form is built by those constructions), so no cardigan is carried to prototype and none is engineered — recorded as the stop, not bypassed. Resolving this is an owner-rule question (#111 vs #308), not a wiring gap; I did not weaken the family test.

mission_runtime.advance_pipeline re-walks all fourteen stages from the rows each stage writes, on mjs.seasonal_sentinel daily and after each targeted tournament; completes through cir_engineering in shadow, stops at certification/assets/launch with the evidence, and moves the coverage gap accordingly.

observe.gap_components scores seasonal_timing, search_opportunity and make_time from rows (contribution/creative potential stay absent); intake/regate/advance_pipeline move the pod's gap concepting → engineering → certified → launched.

intake.response_lesson records the pod's response interpretation; intel.pod_learning runs mission_runtime.response_outcomes (orders → launch_sold, 60-day no-sale → launch_failed, escalated cases → complaint) and raises a commercial-execution challenger when contradicted; UNMEASURED with nothing launched.

mission.mission_status computes last scan, changed/new, pod assignments, top uncovered, seasonal adaptations, launch deadlines, comparison results, products launched, conversion/revenue, incidents from rows; the / dashboard renders them.

notes: #308 partial: fitted-garment constructions fail #111's family test at the proposition stage, so no cardigan is engineered; owner-rule question #111 vs #308, not weakened
held winners judged via provider.see only when a board is filed and vision_usable; otherwise waiting_on named
